items.title: SAMPLE: Course material needs survey
items.description: Tell us which courses you need materials for. Replace this entry with a real form.

guide.title: 1. Create a Google Form
guide.body: Go to forms.google.com, click Blank form, add your questions, then use the Settings tab to limit responses or require sign-in if needed.

guide.title: 2. Copy the share link
guide.body: Click Send (top right), choose the link icon, tick Shorten URL, and copy it. Paste it as the url in data/forms.json with a title, description, deadline and status (Open or Closed).

guide.title: 3. Download responses as PDF
guide.body: Responses tab > link to Sheets > in Sheets choose File > Download > PDF. Or in Forms use the three-dot menu > Print all responses and save as PDF.
